value.interpretation: One declared step: k0 move 'back_to_wick' (20 ft, Aero's remaining movement) to end beside Wick; end_turn true and validation reports TURN_ENDS (bonus action unspent, forfeited). No speech, so nothing is asked of Wick. Leaving the near hound's reach without Disengage provokes; the player confirmed the warning. The near hound (a no-morale drill program that closes and bites) spends its reaction on an opportunity attack as Aero leaves its reach. Then Aero's turn ends and the round proceeds in initiative order: Wick (12), hound_1, hound_2, hound_3 (9, hidden, gm_only), then Aero's round-2 turn_start. WHISPER context (fear felt; shows controlled, jaw set, saber up; motive keep Wick covered) is PC-private: NPCs react only to what is visible (Aero arriving beside Wick, saber up).
value.tables: OA (hound_1 reaction, Regular): bite 1d20+3 vs Aero AC 13; natural 20 crits (2d6+1); hit 1d6+1 piercing, rolled only after a hit. If Aero reaches 0 HP the sim deck cuts power and the drill ends (encounter_end), nobody else acts. Wick turn: deterministic from GM_LEDGER behaviour, no roll: no hound is within 20 ft of him (hound_1 25+ ft, hound_2 ~50 ft) so he does not fire; Aero is now beside him and the near hound is coming, so he steps 5 ft back to put Aero between himself and hound_1, pistol up; no action spent. hound_1 turn: nearest party member is Aero (25 ft; Wick 30 ft behind him); moves 20 ft to Aero (no reach left) and bites: 1d20+3 vs AC 13, hit 1d6+1, nat 20 crit 2d6+1. hound_2 turn: circles the right wall toward Wick, 40 ft move; ends ~15 ft from Wick, cannot reach him this turn, no attack (no Dash: the program attacks when it can reach). hound_3 turn (gm_only): round 1 and nobody came within 10 ft of the crate line, so it stays hidden and still; spends nothing. Aero round 2 budget: action 1, bonus 1, reaction 1 (if unspent? reaction resets at his turn start), object interaction 1, 30 ft.

npc_evaluations.basis: GM_LEDGER: frightened, wants to stay near Aero, never advances on a hound, fires only at a hound within 20 ft with a clear line. None is within 20 ft; Aero has just come back beside him with the near hound 25 ft off, so he steps back behind Aero, pistol up. Aero made no request; Wick knows nothing of Aero's private feelings, only that he looks set and has his saber up.

Drill program, no morale: closes on the nearest party member and bites. Wounded (4/9) changes nothing for a construct. Aero leaving its reach without Disengage provokes; it uses its reaction. On its turn Aero is nearest.
Drill program: circles the right wall toward Wick and attacks him when it can reach him; ~50 ft away with speed 40, so it closes along the wall and cannot attack this turn.

Drill program: stays hidden in round 1 unless found or someone comes within 10 ft of the crate line. Nobody searched; Aero and Wick end about 20 ft from it, moving away. From round 2 it rushes the party member farthest from the other.
